# Signal

A durable, claimable flag that a monitored source changed in a way that needs judgment. Created
deterministically; acted on by an agent or human.

frontmatter.title: Signal
frontmatter.description: A durable, claimable flag that a monitored source changed in a way that needs judgment. Created deterministically; acted on by an agent or human.

descriptions.change_kind: What changed, in the vocabulary of whoever raised the Signal: new, changed, canceled, disappeared, page-changed, status-check, or a kind a profile or intake defines.
descriptions.provider: The monitored source, as its feed URL or a tool name.
descriptions.external_id: The provider's id for the record the Signal is about.
descriptions.diff_summary: What changed, in one paragraph a claimant can judge without opening the source.
descriptions.resolution: What was done and why, written by whoever closed the signal.
descriptions.content_digest: Digest of the observed external record that raised this signal; used to deduplicate and collapse repeated changes.
descriptions.about_doc: Document id the signal concerns (cross-bundle references are not links).

documents.body:
# Source Feed

A monitored source and the policy for what its changes may do: which fields it owns and which
changes need judgment.

frontmatter.title: Source Feed
frontmatter.description: A monitored source (structured feed, official page or declared Connector source) and the policy for what its changes may do: which fields it owns and which changes need judgment.

descriptions.url: The provider identity of the feed, as documents name it in `sources[].resource`. For a Connector source, a resource its identity template admits, byte for byte.
descriptions.owned_fields: Fields this feed is authoritative for. The overlay may write only these; editor-owned fields are refused. For a Connector source, a subset of the source's mapping keys.
descriptions.connector: For a Connector-backed feed, the id of the Connector document (connectors/<slug>).
descriptions.source: For a Connector-backed feed, the name of the Connector source this feed binds to.
descriptions.feed_kind: How the source is read. One of: ics, rss, json-api, html-page, connector.
descriptions.target_kind: The Kind of the documents this feed overlays. For a Connector source, the source's target Kind.
descriptions.auto_apply: Change kinds applied without judgment (e.g. changed).
descriptions.needs_review: Change kinds that raise a Signal for an agent or human (e.g. new, canceled, disappeared, page-changed).
descriptions.completeness: Whether one observation lists every current record for its window. Only a complete feed may ever imply that a record disappeared. One of: complete, partial. A Connector source's value wins.
descriptions.missing_threshold: Consecutive complete observations a record must be absent from before a `disappeared` change is raised.
descriptions.exclude_pattern: Editorial exclusion: a case-insensitive pattern on record titles. Matching records are still observed and stored but never presented.
descriptions.retention: Whether observed records may be captured into a published snapshot (snapshot-ok) or may only be shown live (live-only), per the provider's terms. One of: snapshot-ok, live-only.
descriptions.profile: Name of the provider profile that decodes this source. A Connector source's value wins.
descriptions.extract_rule: For configurable profiles: the extraction rule as JSON text. Configuration, not code.
descriptions.wall_time_zone: IANA zone to read this provider's times in when it labels local wall-clock times as UTC. A recorded judgment for one feed, set only with evidence; never guessed and never a default.
descriptions.terms_url: The provider's terms of use for this source.
descriptions.rights_note: What the provider's terms allow, in a sentence.
descriptions.last_observed_at: When the source was last observed.
